# TEST-ONLY TLS fixtures

Generated by `generate.sh` (OpenSSL) for watchme_io's loopback tests. The
private keys are committed on purpose and are therefore public: never trust
these certificates anywhere else.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `ca.pem` / `ca.key` | Test CA |
| `server.pem` / `server.key` | `127.0.0.1` server certificate signed by the test CA |
| `selfsigned.pem` / `selfsigned.key` | Self-signed `127.0.0.1` certificate, like a TV's |
| `client.pem` / `client.key` | Client certificate signed by the test CA (mutual TLS) |
